gp.message:
================================================================================
FLEX GUI PRO YA AFTER EFFECTS - ZATSOPANO
Mtundu 9.2.8  -  Okutobala 2026
================================================================================

Panel tsopano imalankhula ZINENERO 132, pali ma theme atsopano a DEMON SLAYER okhala ndi
lupanga lomwe limadula mabatani omwe mukudina, komanso kukonza pang'ono kwa kapangidwe ndi kwa Windows.

MUSANAYAMBE
- Ikani pamwamba pa mtundu wanu wapano pogwiritsa ntchito ZXP installer yanu yanthawi zonse, kenako
  yambitsaninso After Effects kamodzi.
- Zokonda zanu, theme, ma preset ndi ma expression osungidwa zimasungidwa.

ZATSOPANO: PANEL M'ZINENERO 132
- Zokonda za Flex > CHINENERO tsopano chili ndi zinenero 132, ndi bokosi losakira.
  Sankhani chimodzi ndipo panel yonse imasintha: ma tab, mabatani, ma tooltip, mauthenga.
- Chinenero chilichonse chinamasuliridwa ndi AI kuchokera ku panel ya Chingerezi, osati liwu
  ndi liwu. Mayina omwe mumawona mu project yanu (mayina a ma layer, mayina a ma effect)
  amakhalabe mu Chingerezi kuti agwirizanebe ndi After Effects.
- Zenera la "zatsopano" limamasuliridwanso, kuyambira mtundu uwu.

ZATSOPANO: MA THEME A DEMON SLAYER
- Zokonda za Flex > THEME SELECTOR ili ndi gulu latsopano la DEMON SLAYER lokhala ndi ma theme 11:
  Giyu, Hinokami Kagura, Shinobu, Mitsuri, Rengoku, Zenitsu, Nezuko,
  Muichiro, Inosuke, Tengen ndi Kokushibo.
- Sunthani mbewa pa panel ndipo chinthu cha theme chimakutsatirani: madzi,
  malawi, mphezi, agulugufe, masamba a maluwa, chifunga ndi zina zambiri. Mbewa
  ikaima, chimazimiririka pang'onopang'ono.
- Dinani batani ndipo lupanga la munthu ameneyo limadula batani limenelo. Gwirani
  batani lamanzere ndipo limapitiriza kudula; ligwireni kwa masekondi pafupifupi 2.5 ndipo limaphulika.
- Zapangidwa kuti zikhale zopepuka: zotsatira zimagwira ntchito pokhapokha mukasuntha kapena kudina, ndipo
  zimadzipepukitsa zokha pa makompyuta apang'onopang'ono. Zimitsani AMBIENT EFFECTS
  mu Theme Selector kuti musunge mitundu yokha.

ZASINTHA: MABATANI OSALALA M'MA THEME ONSE
- Mabatani ogwira ntchito panopa ndi mabatani akulu m'ma theme amitundu sagwiritsanso
  ntchito gradient yamthunzi kuchokera pamwamba kupita pansi. Tsopano ndi mtundu umodzi wosalala
  wokhala ndi kuwala kofewa, motero amaoneka oyera komanso kuwerengeka bwino.

ZAKONZEDWA
- Khadi la laisensi ndi zenera la "zatsopano" zinkatha kutseguka limodzi pamwamba pa linzake.
  Tsopano sizikuphimbana konse, ndipo baji ya SINTHANI siphimbanso
  mabatani apamwamba pa panel.
- Pa UI SCALE 125% ndi 150%, mawindo ena (monga Zokonda za Flex) ankatha kukhala aatali kuposa
  panel, choncho batani lotsekera linkachoka m'maso. Tsopano zenera lililonse
  limakwana pa kukula kulikonse.
- Windows: AutoCaptions imatha kunena kuti "NVIDIA DRIVER NDI YACHIKALE KWAMBIRI KWA GPU
  CAPTIONS" pa makadi ndi ma driver atsopano (RTX 40 ndi 50 series). Tsopano imawerenga
  bwino chithandizo cha CUDA cha driver ndipo imagwiritsa ntchito GPU yanu.

ZOSASINTHA
- Laisensi, activation ndi maulalo onse zimagwira ntchito monga kale.
- Tabu ina iliyonse ndi chida chilichonse zimagwira ntchito monga mu mtundu 9.2.7.
================================================================================

FLEX ULTIMATE YA PREMIERE PRO - ZATSOPANO
Mtundu 2.2.8  -  Okutobala 2026

Ma caption a CAPTION STACK tsopano ndi ma template a Motion Graphics OSINTHIKA okhala ndi editor
yeniyeni, pali AUDIO STUDIO yatsopano ndi LEMBANI BEAT ZA AUDIO, panel imalankhula ZINENERO 132,
UI SCALE yafika mu ULTIMATE, ndipo pali ma theme atsopano a DEMON SLAYER.

MUSANAYAMBE
- Ikani pamwamba pa mtundu wanu wapano pogwiritsa ntchito ZXP installer yanu yanthawi zonse, kenako
  yambitsaninso Premiere Pro kamodzi.
- Zokonda zanu, theme ndi ma preset zimasungidwa.

ZATSOPANO: CAPTION STACK - MA CAPTION OSINTHIKA (FX & ADV RIGS > CAPTION STACK)
- Ma caption tsopano amaikidwa ngati ma template a Motion Graphics osinthika (Output >
  MOGRT YOSINTHIKA, njira yatsopano yoyambira mu Premiere Pro 2026). Mukawaika,
  sinthani liwu lililonse, font, mtundu, kukula, malo, glow, outline, bokosi,
  animation kapena nthawi mu Essential Graphics panel ya Premiere.
- Output > IMAGES imaikabe liwu lililonse ngati chithunzi chokhala ndi mawonekedwe enieni,
  ngati mukufuna zimenezo.
- Ma template amabwera ndi panel. Palibe choti mutsitse.

ZATSOPANO: CAPTION STACK EDITOR
- Preview tsopano ikuwonetsa chithunzi chenicheni cha vidiyo yanu pansi pa caption iliyonse.
- Kokani caption kuti muisunthe, gwiritsani ntchito ngodya kusintha kukula ndi kadontho ka pamwamba
  kuti muizungulitse, dinani kawiri liwu kuti musinthe. CAPTION YONSE imasuntha mawu onse
  pamodzi, LIWU LIMODZI limasuntha liwu limodzi lokha.
- Sankhani ngati kusintha kugwire pa caption iliyonse kapena caption iyi yokha, ndipo
  sungani ma layout anu kuti muwagwiritsenso ntchito.
- Ma look 10 atsopano a GLOW: Big Wide, Bounce Lime, Candy, Horror, Hook, Typewriter,
  Editorial, Sunset, Slide Yellow ndi Superb.

ZATSOPANO: AUDIO STUDIO (FX & ADV RIGS > AUDIO STUDIO)
- Sankhani audio clip, sankhani effect ndipo dinani GWIRITSANI. Chilichonse chimagwira ntchito pa
  kompyuta yanu.
- Ma preset 30 a kudina kamodzi: Underwater, Bass Boost, Room / Hall / Cathedral /
  Plate reverb, Echo, Telephone, Radio, Megaphone, Robot, Chipmunk, Deep
  Voice, Nightcore, Slowed + Reverb, 8D Audio, Lo-fi, Reverse ndi zina. Ikani
  ma effect ambiri momwe mukufunira, asinthireni dongosolo kapena zimitsani limodzi.
- Reverb imasunga mchira wake: mawu amamveka kupitirira kumapeto kwa clip, ndipo
  imayikidwa kuti palibe chilichonse pa timeline yanu chimene chidzalembedwe pamwamba.
- Zida: Noise Remover, Voice Enhance, Loudness (-14 / -16 / -23 LUFS),
  De-esser, De-click, De-clip, Hum Remover, Compressor, Limiter, EQ, Speed
  ndi Pitch, Noise Gate, Extract Audio.
- STEMS MAKER imagawa nyimbo kukhala mawu oimba ndi nyimbo (kapena ma stem 4). Imatsitsa
  model yake nthawi yoyamba ndipo imakufunsani kaye.
- PREVIEW imakulolani kumva pafupifupi masekondi 8 ndi chosinthira cha Choyambirira / Processed.
  Zotsatira zimapita pa audio track yopanda kanthu ndipo clip yanu yoyambirira imatsekedwa mawu,
  siichotsedwa konse.

ZATSOPANO: LEMBANI BEAT ZA AUDIO (FX & ADV RIGS > LEMBANI BEAT ZA AUDIO)
- Sankhani clip ya nyimbo pa timeline ndipo dinani LEMBANI BEAT: Flex imapeza
  ma beat ndikuwonjezera ma sequence marker pa iwo, kuti kudula kwanu kugwirizane bwino
  ndi nyimbo.
- Sankhani ZONSE, ma KICK kapena ma SNARE, sinthani kukhudzika, ndipo lembani beat iliyonse
  kapena beat iliyonse yachiwiri kapena yachinayi.
- CHOTSANI MA BEAT MARKER imachotsa ma marker okha omwe Flex yawonjezera. Imagwira ntchito pa
  kompyuta yanu.

ZATSOPANO: PANEL M'ZINENERO 132
- Zokonda > CHINENERO tsopano chili ndi zinenero 132, ndi bokosi losakira. Ma tab,
  mabatani, ma tooltip ndi mauthenga zonse zimasintha. Zenera la "zatsopano" limamasuliridwanso,
  kuyambira mtundu uwu.
